violated_contract: A test that drives code with an age-based policy window (lookback, retention, expiry, freshness) must not feed it a fixed calendar date. The fixture passes until the wall clock carries that date across the window, then every commit fails with no product change.
canonical_prevention: Derive such fixture timestamps from the current time at a stated age well inside (or deliberately outside) the window, or inject the clock the policy reads. Share one helper so the intended age is named once.
